detail: raw exception normalised to UNEXPECTED_ERROR: Cannot convert undefined to a BigInt
note: PUSH_BIGINT does BigInt(strings[opcodes[ip++]]) with no check that the operand indexes a real string, so a one-byte program reaches BigInt(undefined). Bytecode-only: the compiler never emits an out-of-range index. vm/VM.ts, PUSH_BIGINT case. FIXED: operandByte() in vm/VM.ts refuses an operand read past the end of the stream, so a one-byte [PUSH_BIGINT] program raises MALFORMED_BYTECODE_TRUNCATED instead of reaching BigInt(undefined). PUSH_BIGINT additionally parses its pooled literal through parseBigIntLiteral(), which turns V8s SyntaxError into MALFORMED_BYTECODE_BIGINT_LITERAL.
